verdict.rationale: Jeeves has a dedicated webhooks integration guide offering real-time HTTP notifications when card transactions are approved, declined, settled, or fail, with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. Its Instant Pay product also advertises real-time webhooks, so programmatic consumers can receive outbound event callbacks. missing for 10: documented endpoint registration/subscription management, a broader event catalog beyond card transactions and payments, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
